title: Dharma
desc: Intolerant of injustice, Dharma is arrested for killing a man for molesting his sister. Upon his release, he becomes a powerful gangster to fight off evil in society.

title: Engeyo Ketta Kural
desc: Ponni wants to live a lavish life but gets married to her cousin Kumaran. Her love for worldly pleasures makes her abandon Kumaran and her daughter for a richer man.

title: Palakkattu Madhavan
desc: Madhavan, frustrated by his wife Lakshmi's success, adopts Pattu Maami, an elderly woman, for financial gain. But as their bond grows, Madhavan faces unexpected life changes and emotional growth.

title: Kaivantha Kalai
desc: Kannan and his father scam their fellow villagers until Kannan falls in love with a girl, Kausalya. Her only demand is for him to leave his crooked ways if he wants a future with her.

title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after her father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.
